config.trainable: roi_heads.box_predictor only; all other parameters and backbone buffers frozen

gate.note: Illustrative offline gate; insufficient night support yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never PASS

protocol: Warm-start on seed only; freeze pool inference; 3 paired seeds x 3 samplers. All candidates start from the SAME warm-start checkpoint. No test-driven selection or hyperparameter search. Pilot, not significance study.
